description.value: The Bund Shanghai Cuisine & Bar is a Chinese restaurant and bar on White Rock's scenic Marine Drive, specializing in Shanghai-style dishes alongside Sichuan and Cantonese favourites. The menu spans dim sum staples like soup dumplings and a full Peking duck service alongside a broad selection of wok dishes. Situated on one of the Lower Mainland's most popular waterfront cycling corridors, it offers a full sit-down meal or online pickup for cyclists on the move.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at thebundbar.com is fully accessible and confirms the business is active with online ordering (pickup in 15 min), 48 reviews, and a phone number (604-385-6099) absent from OSM. The menu legend lists 'vegetarian' as a label, and the menu includes multiple vegetarian-suitable dishes (edamame, tofu, cucumber salad, vegetable stir-fry). No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: Phone number (604-385-6099) is confirmed on website but was absent from OSM record; added from website.
Bike parking and washroom availability not mentioned on website or in OSM tags — on-site verification recommended.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active restaurant on Marine Drive — a heavily cycled waterfront corridor in White Rock — with confirmed online pickup ordering and vegetarian menu options; a useful stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu legend explicitly includes a 'vegetarian' label; multiple vegetarian dishes are listed (edamame, cucumber salad, deep-fried tofu, stir-fried vegetables, yam fries, etc.)
